answer: An adversary running 61 aliases thus needs 49 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in tundra, expire in karst, and yarrow lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 21 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4658 identities would post 3857 proofs and burn roughly 36 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
